title: Open the training room from the title screen
setup: Press Play to mount the training room and give the player control. The menu hides after the local player spawns.

title: Host or join a four-player salvage run
setup: The same menu can host the salvage yard or join another player's address. Both copies use the same scenes and UDP port.

title: Host a duo or squad from the co-op menu
setup: In a project with serialized game definitions, pick Duo or Squad before hosting or joining. Both peers use the same seat count and port.

title: Open a drop-in co-op practice room
setup: Open the practice room so friends can join while a match is already running. Assign a player scene and a world with four spawn points.

title: Show the rules in a co-op pause menu
setup: The pause screen tells players how many seats the match has and whether friends can still join.

title: Enter and exit a solo practice range
setup: Select **Enter** to start an offline practice session with the range's player camera. Select **Leave** to return to the menu. [Build a solo scene](/quickstart)

title: Choose first-person or chase view before spawning
setup: Choose first-person or chase view before entering a solo range. The first-person view hides the player's body while the chase view keeps it visible.
